tort.headline: Infection, blood clot, or a port that broke? Find out where you stand.
tort.lede: Thousands of people had a Bard PowerPort implanted for chemo or long-term treatment. Some suffered infections, blood clots, or catheter pieces that broke off and moved. If that happened to you, you may have a claim, and we don't get paid unless you do.
